name: Praful Kumar
title: Full Stack Engineer | React | Angular | Node.js | Python | AWS
tagline: Building scalable web applications that solve real-world problems
bio: Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience designing and building scalable web applications using React, Angular, Node.js, and Python. Skilled in REST API development, microservices architecture, and cloud deployment on AWS. Experienced in building search systems with Elasticsearch, optimizing databases, and implementing CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.

experience.description: Led frontend development using Angular and React, delivering responsive and accessible interfaces for multiple enterprise products. Designed backend architecture for scalable REST APIs using Node.js and FastAPI. Implemented Elasticsearch-based full-text search, enabling scalable, high-speed querying across large datasets. Designed and optimized MongoDB and MySQL schemas, improving query performance and supporting scalable backend services.

Delivered 7+ full-stack web applications using MERN stack and Angular. Designed backend architecture and REST APIs using Node.js and Express.js, implementing JWT authentication. Managed cloud server deployments on AWS (EC2, S3). Integrated CI/CD pipelines, reducing manual deployment overhead and improving release frequency. Automated server-side operations using cron jobs and shell scripts.

Built and maintained dynamic web applications using PHP, Angular, HTML, and CSS, contributing to 7+ successful client projects. Managed and optimized MySQL databases for efficient data storage and retrieval. Designed responsive, user-friendly interfaces improving user engagement. Automated server-side processes with cron jobs and shell scripts.
